name: U-G-O
description: U-G-O is a combat card game for two or more players where each player uses their own 52-card deck (different backs). Cards are played vertically (attack) or horizontally (defense). Players attack opponents' cards by playing higher-valued cards. Defense cards may be played face-up or face-down. Goal: exhaust your opponent's deck before yours runs out. Special abilities on Aces, Kings, Queens, Jacks, 8s, 9s, and 10s; Equip cards (Diamonds) and suit abilities (Spades, Hearts, Clubs).

history.origins: U-G-O was invented in 2003 by Michael Daniel as an affordable home alternative to trading-card games like Yu-Gi-Oh. Daniel created it because his children wanted collectible card games but he could not afford them; he designed U-G-O so that each player uses a standard 52-card deck with different backs. The game proved popular with his children and their school friends, in part because many schools allow standard playing cards but prohibit trading cards. It has no earlier folk or commercial lineage.
timeline: 2003: Invented by Michael Daniel as a home alternative to trading-card games; first published online that year.

setup.deck: 1 deck per player (different backs). Shuffle, pass to left. Draw 5.
setup.dealing: Each player shuffles their deck, passes it to the left, and draws five cards from the deck they received.

rules.objective: To make your opponent(s) run out of cards in their deck before you run out of cards in your deck.
rules.gameplay: Draw 1/turn. Play cards vertically (attack) or horizontally (defense). Attack opponent's cards with higher values. Destroyed cards go to discard. Special: 2s, 3s, 7s, 10s have abilities. Lose when unable to draw.

strategy.basic: Play defense early, attack when strong.

variations.name: Standard
variations.description: Default rules as described: one Attack/Defense card per turn, special cards, equip cards, attack/defense positions.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Standard is the base game; no engine overrides needed.

variations.name: Ace variants (optional)
variations.description: Aces can be given suit-specific targets: Spades on all attack-position cards, Hearts on all defense-position, Clubs on all A/D cards, Diamonds on all Equip cards.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Optional rule variant; engine uses base Ace behavior until overrides are defined.

variations.name: Nine counter (optional)
variations.description: When a Special card is used on you, you may take their card and use it on them instead. Especially good for two-player.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Optional counter rule; engine would need custom logic to add this variant.

synthesis.shortDescription: U-G-O is a card battle game for 2-8 players where each player uses their own deck. Cards are played vertically (attack) or horizontally (defense). Players attack with higher-valued cards; special and Equip cards have unique effects.
